text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the "Arima Kinen" has finally 
arrived. The dream of running in a GⅠ race 
together is about to come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Cross the finish line leaving Dia-chan 
behind!" "Cross the finish line one step 
ahead of Kita-chan!" Their one-of-a-kind 
dream race begins!
